## SIPP

```{r}
library(here)

if (Sys.info()["sysname"] == "Windows") {
  base_dir <- "G:/Shared drives/Undocu Research"
} else {
  base_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-vsovero@ucr.edu/Shared drives/Undocu Research"
}

# 2. Build the specific folder paths dynamically using file.path()
data_path <- file.path(base_dir, "Data")
figures_path <- file.path(base_dir, "Output", "Figures")

library(arrow)
library(readr)


sipp08_2_new <- read_parquet(file.path(data_path, "temp_new_SIPP.parquet"))
sipp08_2_old <- read_parquet(file.path(data_path, "temp_cleaned_SIPP.parquet"))


#sipp08_2_new <- read_parquet(file.path(data_path, "sipp_2008_w2_merged.parquet"))
#sipp08_2_old <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "(Step 1 output) Core_TM SIPP 2008 Wave 2.csv"))
```

```{r}
table(sipp08_2_old$eeducate)
table(sipp08_2_new$EEDUCATE)

# This shows exactly how each raw EEDUCATE code mapped to yrsed, including NAs
#table(sipp08_2_old$EEDUCATE, sipp08_2_old$yrsed, useNA = "always")
```

```{r}
library(arrow)
setwd(data_path)


vars <- c("undocu_likely", "central_latino", "bpl_asia", "medicaid", "age", "fem", 
           "married", "cit_spouse", "nonfluent", "spanish_hispanic_latino", 
           "household_size", "poverty", "asian", "black", "white", "other_race", 
           "employed", "years_us", "yrsed")
```

```{r}
invisible(lapply(vars, function(v) {
  cat("\n========================================\n", toupper(v), "\n")
  cat("Class -> Old:", class(sipp08_2_old[[v]])[1], " | New:", class(sipp08_2_new[[v]])[1], "\n")
  cat("----------------------------------------\nOld:\n")
  print(summary(sipp08_2_old[[v]]))
  cat("New:\n")
  print(summary(sipp08_2_new[[v]]))
}))
```

## ACS

```{r}
library(here)

if (Sys.info()["sysname"] == "Windows") {
  base_dir <- "G:/Shared drives/Undocu Research"
} else {
  base_dir <- "~/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-vsovero@ucr.edu/Shared drives/Undocu Research"
}

# 2. Build the specific folder paths dynamically using file.path()
data_path <- file.path(base_dir, "Data")
figures_path <- file.path(base_dir, "Output", "Figures")

library(arrow)
library(readr)


ACS_target_new <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "incomplete_ACS_SIPP.csv"))
ACS_target_old <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "new_ACS_SIPP.csv"))
```

```{r}
library(arrow)
setwd(data_path)


ACS_vars <- c("gbm_undocu_p", "central_latino", "bpl_asia", "medicaid", "age", "fem", 
           "married", "cit_spouse", "nonfluent", "spanish_hispanic_latino", 
           "household_size", "poverty", "asian", "black", "white", "other_race", 
           "employed", "years_us", "yrsed")
```

```{r}
invisible(lapply(ACS_vars, function(v) {
  cat("\n========================================\n", toupper(v), "\n")
  cat("Class -> Old:", class(ACS_target_old[[v]])[1], " | New:", class(ACS_target_new[[v]])[1], "\n")
  cat("----------------------------------------\nOld:\n")
  print(summary(ACS_target_old[[v]]))
  cat("New:\n")
  print(summary(ACS_target_new[[v]]))
}))
```
